authority.rule: Tony alone selects, approves, merges, and publishes. No session reviews, accepts, or merges its own work.

purpose: Split the future code work implied by this narrative into non-overlapping domains, so four packets can be cut without a path collision, a copy collision, or a second author on any head.

frozenPaths.rule: Read-only for every domain below. Not in any allowlist. A single changed byte fails the packet.

seam.name: single-writer-of-app-page
seam.statement: app/page.tsx is leased to exactly one domain — D2. D1 and D3 publish contract modules and components; D2 is the only domain that edits the page that mounts them. This follows the precedent already committed at the base in src/components/home/premiumWorkbenchHero.contract.ts (BLUEPRINT_MOTION_SLOT_CONTRACT), where a reserved region and a published contract let two workers compose without sharing a file.
seam.consequence: D1 and D3 must land before D2 mounts them, or D2 mounts against the published contract and the component follows. Either order is legal; a shared edit to app/page.tsx is not.

domains.name: header-and-hero
domains.singleOutcome: The first fold and the site chrome present a premium ADU and general-construction business, with the release-status truth delivered as one calm line.
blockedBy: Hero art direction is unresolved until #246 is decided. Copy (U1-K, U1-H, U1-B1, U1-B2, U1-C1, U1-C2, U1-D) is specified and may be landed independently of the art.
acceptance: First-fold copy equals copy-deck IDs U1-K, U1-H, U1-B1, U1-B2 byte-for-byte, pinned by a test in the same way the base already pins PREMIUM_WORKBENCH_HERO_COPY.
Media disclosure U1-D renders inside the fold that contains the image, at every viewport.
Chapter rail renders exactly HERO_CHAPTER_LABELS: Lead, Project, Record.
Motion is one unattended pass, then rest; prefers-reduced-motion renders one complete legible frame.
The header brand mark is adjudicated against the Product 1 pulsing-dot prohibition, with the verdict recorded on the packet.
npm test && npm run lint && npm run build green at the exact head; Preview reviewed by the Owner with eyes before any merge.

domains.name: post-hero-narrative
domains.singleOutcome: The homepage below the fold carries units U2 through U7 in order, and is the only place any of them is mounted.
dependsOn: D1 contract (mount point of the hero)
D3 component or its published contract (mount point of the bridge)
acceptance: Exactly six sections between the hero and the bridge, in the order U2, U3, U4, U5, U6, U7. A seventh section fails the packet.
Every rendered sentence appears in copy-deck.md; a sentence not in the deck fails the packet.
Every DESIGN_TARGET sentence renders inside the same section as its boundary line: U3-D with U3-B2..U3-B4, U5-D with U5-B1..U5-B3.
Every CTA resolves to a route present in publicRouteRegistry at the exact head; the Residential Addition card carries no link.
No public string in the diff matches the AI-vocabulary ban list; enforced by a mutation-tested vitest rule.
Desktop and mobile reading orders match homepage-journey.md at 1440x900, 820x1180, and 390x844.
Page motion budget: one U3 step sequence and at most one U5 connection, each once; everything else static.
npm test && npm run lint && npm run build green at the exact head; Preview reviewed by the Owner with eyes before any merge.

domains.name: deedseal-bridge
domains.singleOutcome: The lower-page Deedseal bridge is its own quiet module, rendering the frozen sentence byte-exact with both committed destinations intact.
dependsOn: P2-DEEDSEAL-PROOF-BRIDGE-0001 (#248) for any copy beyond the frozen sentence
blockedBy: U8-X1, U8-X2, U8-X3, U8-X4 are EVIDENCE_REQUIRED and tagged DEPENDS_ON_248. None may be authored inside this domain.
acceptance: DEEDSEAL_CROSS_REFERENCE_SENTENCE renders byte-exact, assembled from the frozen constants and never re-typed as a literal.
The single linked word is proof, resolving to DEEDSEAL_PUBLIC_URL; the record link uses DEEDSEAL_PROOF_RECORD_LABEL and DEEDSEAL_PROOF_RECORD_URL verbatim.
git diff of src/lib/deedsealCrossReference.ts against the base is empty; blob SHA still caa6e9c26f33d164229747f8a1f855c0d0186ae3.
No heading, no logo, no wordmark, no seal, no passport or box metaphor, no pulsing dot, no entrance motion.
The module reads as calm and subordinate to the construction narrative at every viewport.
npm test && npm run lint && npm run build green at the exact head; Preview reviewed by the Owner with eyes before any merge.

domains.name: exact-head-visual-qa
domains.singleOutcome: One independent, non-author read-only verdict on the composed page at one exact head.
consumesReadOnly: the composed head produced by D1, D2, and D3
acceptance: Verdict pinned to one exact 40-character head SHA; a new commit voids it and requires a fresh review.
Reviewer declares its own model, lane, and session, and states non-authorship explicitly. The author of the head can never review it.
Screenshots at 1440x900, 820x1180, and 390x844, plus one prefers-reduced-motion pass.

Checks: eight units in order; every sentence present in copy-deck.md; every DESIGN_TARGET boundary line co-located; every CTA resolves; frozen sentence byte-exact; no pulsing dot or Product 1 identity device anywhere; no AI-category vocabulary or imagery.
Terminal verdict is exactly NO BLOCKING FINDING or BLOCKED FOR REVISION.

pathLeaseCheck.note: No path appears in the ownsPaths of more than one domain. app/page.tsx is leased to D2 alone; src/lib/deedsealCrossReference.ts is leased to nobody.

sequencing.reason: Disjoint leases and no mutual dependency. D1 is gated on the Owner's #246 selection for art only; its copy is independent.
Sole writer of app/page.tsx; mounts D1's hero and D3's bridge.
Independent read-only verdict at one composed exact head.

globalProhibitions: No route created, renamed, redirected, or removed.
No price, date, schedule, availability, certification, licence, partnership, completed-project, testimonial, or metric claim.
No autonomous-AI claim, and no automated actor as the subject of a decision verb.
No completed Deedseal-integration claim; Powered by Deedseal is not shippable present-tense copy.
No AI faces, chat bubbles, robot workforce, cyberpunk network, or AI-powered category framing.
No Product 1 green pulsing dot, and no device that reads as it.
No mutation of any deedseal/* repository, no Product 1 change.
No weakening of an existing test; new visual or copy rules must be mutation-tested.
No PII, no real customer facts, no parcel or permit identifiers.
No Preview, Production, DNS, secret, access, or billing change from a narrative packet.

gates.requirement: All three green at the exact head of every mutation domain.
gates.previewRule: Preview is worker-created engineering evidence and never Owner acceptance. A docs-only diff claims no Preview at all.
gates.ownerGate: Tony judges the Preview with his eyes before any merge. Textual description of the result is not a substitute.

openDependencies.what: Owner selection of one Hero visual direction.
A public integration record between Product 2 and Product 1.
blocks: every present-tense integration formulation, including Powered by Deedseal
doesNotBlock: the frozen first-user sentence, which is already adopted and published
